content.value: . A centrifugal pump pumping water operates at 35 m<sup>3</sup> /hr and at 1440 RPM. The pump operating efficiency is 68% and motor efficiency is 90%. The discharge pressure gauge shows 4.4 kg/ cm <sup>2.</sup> The suction is 2.0 m below the pump centerline. If the speed of the pump is reduced by 50%, estimate the (i) new flow, (ii) head, and (iii) power.
